summary: Added sdk/reports/pvp.py: wilson_interval, RoleStats, ScorecardRow, compute_scorecard (per alias/strategy/cohort; known-result rates; unknowns counted separately; net observed trophies; resource spend), StrategyComparison and compare_strategies (recommend only with min_sample known results per side and non-overlapping 95% intervals, blocked when cohorts disagree), plus JSON and Markdown output. JournalBattle carries the event cost. Exported from sdk.reports. 16 tests in tests/test_pvp_scorecard.py, including journal-to-scorecard flow. Documented in docs/baseline/pvp-scorecard.md.

contract_status_changes.contract: R3 PvP scorecard and strategy comparison
contract_status_changes.before: No offense/defense scorecard by cohort and no rule for when a strategy comparison is conclusive
contract_status_changes.after: Scorecards report known-result win rates with intervals; recommendations require sample size and separated intervals

residual_risks: Until a trophy read is verified live, journaled outcomes are unknown and the scorecard reports counts only.
Defenses are not journaled yet (only attacks are run actions), so defense rows stay empty.
